analyticsDisabledWarning: We strongly recommend keeping this enabled so we can find and fix issues faster.
apiAgentsDescription: Run transcription from scripts, CLI tools, or AI agents using ShiorikoTrans's local API.
askForDownloadModel: Would you like to download the model from the website
askForInstallYtdlpMessage: Do you want to install ytdlp which is used for downloading audio from popular websites?
askForRelaunchBody: Do you want to relaunch now?
askForUpdateBody: Do you want to update shiorikotrans into version {version}?
askForUpdateYtdlpMessage: New ytdlp version found. Do you want to update ytdlp?
confirmExit: Do you want to exit? Unsaved changes will be lost.
crashedRecently: Since the app is crashed recently, the GPU is disabled. you can enable it in the settings.
customizeInfo: Download any supported model in ggml or gguf format (with the file extension ending in '.bin'). Transfer it to the models directory, then select from the dropdown. No need to restart 🌟
downloadDiarizeModel: Speaker diarization requires a model (~25MB). Download it now?
globalDictationPromo: Press a shortcut anywhere to instantly transcribe. Works while ShiorikoTrans runs in the background.
globalHotkeyDescription: Hold the shortcut to record, release to transcribe.
hotkeyActivationPushToTalkDescription: Hold the shortcut to record, then release it to transcribe.
hotkeyActivationToggleDescription: Press once to start recording, then press again to stop and transcribe.
dictationIndicatorSettingInfo: Shows a small floating ShiorikoTrans indicator while global dictation is listening and transcribing.
normalizeHotkeyOutputInfo: Collapses line breaks and extra spaces into single spaces, so the result is one clean line of text instead of multiple lines.
infoCancelDownload: You can cancel and download the model manually later.
infoDiarizeThreshold: Threshold for speaker recognition or consider as not detected
infoDiarization: Detect and label different speakers in the audio. Requires downloading a separate model.
infoEnableLogs: Write logs to file. Please restart after enabling it.
infoGpuDevice: Select the GPU device for transcription. Enter the GPU device number, starting from 0. If you have 2 GPUs, choose either 0 or 1.
infoHighGpuPerformance: Enhances graphics performance for ShiorikoTrans, but will consume more system resources.
infoLlmApiKey: The API key from the website of the AI model
infoLlmPrompt: Prompt for the AI model. Must include the pattern %s which will be replaced with the transcription.
infoLlmSummarize: Summarize with AI. Requires API key. Once the transcription is complete, it will be sent to Claude API along with the chosen prompt and then in a few seconds, the answer from the AI will be displayed in ShiorikoTrans instead of the transcription. Works also when transcribing multiple files!
infoManualDownload: Internet connection is required to download the AI model
infoMaxSentenceLen: How many letters will be in a single sentence. Works only when word timestamps are on.
infoMaxSpeakers: How many speakers should be in the file. Used for more precise recognition
infoMaxTextCtx: Max context tokens to use from the past text as prompt for the decoder
infoMaxTokens: Max tokens for the AI model. Each token is usually considered as a single word. This can save you from sending too much data which costs money. It's recommended to restrict it also in the website.
infoNormalizeLoudness: Enable this option for better transcription accuracy. It may take up to 8 minutes per hour of audio.
infoPrompt: Make transcripts better by writing expected words.
infoRecognizeSpeakers: Detect speaker in each sentence and add it
infoTemperature: Higher values lead to more unique words; lower values stick to common ones. Usually set around 0.4 for a balanced result.
infoThreads: Increase CPU for faster decoding; balance speed with resource usage. Recommended: 4
infoTranslateToEnglish: Translate transcription into English from any language by enabling this option
infoUseWordTimestamps: Transcript with word timestamps instead of sentence timestamps. Useful in JSON format. Disabled when speaker recognition is on.
invalidLlmPrompt: Invalid prompt. It must include the following pattern %s which will be replaced with the transcription.
pleaseEnableWordTimestamps:
Please enable word timestamps to use this option!
Also make sure to disable this option once you finished or reset the model options!
promptMustContainPlaceholder: Prompt must contain %s as a placeholder for the transcript
resetAskDialog: Are you sure you want to reset ShiorikoTrans? App data will be cleared including models files.
recordingSavePathInfo: Choose where to save recorded audio files. Default is Documents/ShiorikoTrans.
gpuFallbackToCpu: GPU failed to load model. Falling back to CPU.
avx2NotSupported: Your CPU is not supported by this version of ShiorikoTrans. Please use a more modern PC.
noModelSelected: Select a model in Settings to get started
downloadDefaultModelDescription: Download the default model to start transcribing.
transcriptWillDisplayedShortly: Transcript will be displayed here shortly...
ytdlpOptionsInfo: ShiorikoTrans uses ytdlp for URL transcription.
stableTimestampsInfo: Uses VAD per-segment decode for tighter subtitle timing. Around 4x slower; best for movie/long-form transcript work.
stableTimestampsSlowNote: Highly accurate timestamps, but around 4x slower.
translateWhisperModelNote: Whisper medium/large only; not v3 Turbo.
samplingStrategyInfo: Greedy vs Beam Search: Default is Beam Search (Size 5, Patience -1), which evaluates 5 possible sequences at each step for more accurate results, but is slower. Greedy, on the other hand, selects the best token from the top 5 at each step, making it faster but potentially less accurate.
greedyInfo: Top candidates in Greedy mode (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
beamInfo: Paths explored in Beam Search (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
stableTimestampsConfirm: Stable timestamps requires a VAD model (~1MB). Download it now?
agentInstructionsCopied: Agent skill instructions copied to clipboard
localApiUnreachable: Could not reach the local API
permissionAudioRecording: Please enable system audio recording in System Settings, then try again.
unloadModelAfterInactivityInfo: Releases model memory and VRAM after there has been no transcription activity. The next transcription may take longer while the model reloads.
zeroMeansNever: Set to 0 to keep the model loaded.
modelSettingsNoOptions: This engine has no tunable parameters yet — only the shared options apply.
appearanceInfo: The theme palette changes the surfaces only, so every accented control stays consistent in both light and dark mode. The accent color can be a preset swatch or any hex value (the '# ' swatch), and a custom background image is drawn behind the translucent cards with an automatic overlay.
modelCatalogInfo: One-click download — files land in the models folder and are usable immediately.
needsVadModel: needs the VAD helper model (downloaded automatically)
customColorHint: Drag the sliders or type a hex value
catalogHintNvidia: 0.6B TDT / RNNT models — fast and multilingual (needs the VAD helper model, downloaded automatically)
catalogHintWhisper: 99 languages, best compatibility — large for accuracy, tiny for speed
catalogHintSenseVoice: Chinese / English / Cantonese / Japanese / Korean, non-autoregressive CTC, extremely fast
enableTranslationInfo: The translation page uses its own engine, model and options — independent from the summarisation model.
engineLocalInfo: Point this at any OpenAI-compatible server on your machine — llama.cpp, LM Studio, Jan or vLLM. Nothing leaves your computer.
translateModelsInfo: Download a model, then load it in your local server. Translation needs far less than chat, so a small model is enough.
soundOnTranslateFinish: Play a sound when translation finishes
needEnableTranslation: Enable translation in Settings → Translation first.
pasteText: Paste text, or pick a .txt/.srt/.vtt file…
translationPlaceholder: The translation appears here; you can keep editing it.
bilingualPlaceholder: Source and translation alternate per paragraph.
needSourceText: Choose a file or paste some text first
speakerLabelsInfo: Writes a [Speaker n] prefix in front of every line in the transcript, the HTML preview and every export (txt / srt / vtt / docx). Engines report a speaker number even when diarization is off — everything is speaker 1 then — so this is off by default.
speakerOptionsHint: Speaker labels only make sense together with speaker diarization. Each model also exposes these options in its own settings dialog.
runtimeDependenciesInfo: ffmpeg decodes and merges audio before transcription. The slim installer does not bundle it (~83 MB) and downloads it on first use; you can also install it yourself or put it on PATH.
ffmpegRequired: ffmpeg is required to decode this file. Download it now (~83 MB)?
accentColorInfo: The accent color drives buttons, switches and highlights. Pick a preset swatch or any hex value; the light/dark variants are derived automatically.
batchDefaultsInfo: Applied when a whole folder is selected (the folder panel on the home page uses the same values).
customBackgroundInfo: The image is drawn behind the translucent cards with an automatic overlay so the text stays readable.
diagnosticsFailed: Could not build the diagnostics report
displayLanguageInfo: Interface language. Switching it also updates the default transcription language.
enableDiagnosticsInfo: Write extra GPU/driver details to the log while troubleshooting.
exportFormatInfo: Default file types used by the save buttons on the transcript and summary panels.
forceCpuModeInfo: Disable GPU acceleration completely — slower, but it still works when the driver misbehaves.
gpuDiagnosticsInfo: Enumerate the devices the accelerator can see and report what each backend returns.
includeSubFoldersInfo: Recurse into sub folders when a whole folder is selected.
infoLogsAndDiagnostics: Logs are always written to a file. Attach the report to a support request — it contains no transcript text.
inputLanguageInfo: Language the model should expect. `auto` lets engines with language detection decide.
modelQuantizationHintInfo: Fallback label used when a model file carries no quantization metadata (e.g. Q4_K_M). `auto` reads it from the file.
modelSettingsInfo: Per-engine decoding options (threads, temperature, prompt…). Engines only show what they support.
modelsFolderInfo: Where model files live. Purpose sub folders (transcribe/translate/vad/diarize) are created automatically.
recentFileMissing: The file “{name}” is no longer on disk
recentFilesInfo: Files transcribed recently. The transcript itself is saved too, so reopening restores the text even when the source file was moved or deleted. Entries whose source only lived in the temp folder are marked as missing.
recentFilesMissingHint: {count} entry(ies) point to files that are gone.
recentLanguagesInfo: Languages picked recently, used to shorten the language menu.
resetAppInfo: Delete the settings, the model metadata and the app store, then start over from the setup wizard.
resetOptionsInfo: Only the decoding/export defaults are restored — models, folders and appearance stay untouched.
saveNextToAudioFileInfo: Write the transcript beside the source file instead of into the chosen output folder.
sectionAdvancedDesc: Logs, diagnostics and the model memory policy.
sectionApiDesc: Expose transcription over a local HTTP API for scripts and agents.
sectionAppearanceDesc: Theme mode, palette, accent color and background.
sectionDictationDesc: Hold a hotkey to dictate anywhere and paste straight into the focused app.
sectionGeneralDesc: Interface language, what happens when a transcription finishes, and export formats.
sectionGpuDesc: Pick the accelerator and see what the backends actually detect.
sectionModelsDesc: Install, pick and manage speech recognition models.
sectionSummarizeDesc: Send the transcript to a language model to summarise, rewrite or translate it.
sectionTranscriptionDesc: Language, speaker handling and the runtime pieces the pipeline needs.
sectionTranslationDesc: Translate transcripts with a local server or a hosted model.
selectedModelInfo: The model used for the next transcription. Per-engine options live behind “Model settings”.
skipIfExistsInfo: Skip files that already have a transcript beside them.
storeRecordInDocumentsInfo: When off, recordings stay in the app temp folder and are deleted on the next launch.
subtitlePresetInfo: One click: word timestamps on, 32-character sentences and SRT as the transcript format.
textDirectionInfo: Reading direction of the transcript editor (needed for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian…).
themeModeInfo: Follow the operating system, or pin light/dark.
themePaletteInfo: Neutral surface palette, independent from the accent color.
viewLogsFailed: Could not load the log file
vulkanDeviceInfo: Pin a specific Vulkan device index. Leave empty to pick automatically.
recentSourceMissingRestored: The source file is gone, so the saved transcript was restored
recentBusyTranscribing: A transcription is running — open history again once it finishes
credits: Thanks to 小丸, shengengfun, DeepSeek and GitHub Copilot
hfMirrorInfo: Rewrite huggingface.co downloads to hf-mirror.com when the official site is slow or blocked.
translateEngineUnreachable: No translation server is listening on {url}. Start a local server (command below) or switch the engine.
localModelMissing: The translation model is not downloaded yet. Open Settings → Translation → Models and download one.
localEngineStartFailed: Could not start the local translation engine: {error}
translationLocalHint: The app downloads llama.cpp itself and starts it when you translate — no manual command needed.
infoSummaryChunkChars: Characters sent per request when the transcript is long. A small local model cannot read a whole transcript at once, so it is summarised part by part and merged afterwards. 0 disables chunking.
needEnableSummarize: Enable summarization in Settings → Summarize first.
sendToSummary: Open the summary tab after transcription
sendToTranslate: Open the translation page after transcription
summarizeEmptyHint: No summary yet. Pick a prompt under Settings → Summarize, then summarize this transcript.
summaryLocalHint: The app downloads llama.cpp itself and starts it when you summarize — no manual command needed.
